status: Preview only. Not imported into game. No build or launch.
shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Original modern military RTS art style approval sheet for Greyhaven, NOT a running game screenshot and NOT a production sprite atlas. Art target: the readability and faction recognition of Red Alert 2 combined with the clean high definition prerendered material finish of Command & Conquer Remastered. Sophisticated semi-realistic RTS unit art, not photorealistic promotional concept painting. Smooth antialiased contours, finely resolved curved and beveled surfaces, coherent directional light from upper left, soft restrained contact shadows, subtle ambient occlusion. Full-resolution rendering with continuous tonal shading. Absolutely NO pixel art, no chunky pixel clusters, no low-poly facets, no cuboid toy forms, no Lego/Minecraft, no chibi proportions, no posterization, no retro low-resolution filter. Deliberately designed readable details: preserve major armor joints, layered equipment and mechanically plausible forms, omit tiny noisy scratches and bolts. Palette: muted grey-olive and warm grey metal with dark graphite rubber; broad clearly integrated cyan-blue faction paint versus brick red faction paint on identical designs. Team panels occupy roughly a third of visible body area, highlight and shade naturally with the material rather than appearing as flat bright plastic. Dark desaturated slate presentation board, quiet thin panel separators, elegant small pale-gold Chinese headings, no decorative HUD, no existing franchise insignia. Isometric orthographic views at 30 degree camera elevation; uniform light and scale within each unit class. Include attractive large study renders and a modest lower band of reduced-size readability studies, clearly illustrations rather than claims of exact runtime pixel size. Composition clean, ample breathing space, no cropped models.

Composition clean, ample breathing space, no cropped models. Landscape high-resolution board headed "载具风格蓝本 · 仅供审阅". Five spacious model panels arranged THREE across top and TWO wider panels across bottom. Label panels "步兵战车", "主战坦克", "自行火炮", "工程车", "采矿车". Each panel has one large cyan-blue faction three-quarter front view and one smaller matching red-faction three-quarter rear view. Make shapes sophisticated and plausible rather than primitive boxes. IFV: narrow eight-wheel angled armored hull, high troop compartment, small turret and short autocannon, wheel suspension clearly readable. MBT: broad low tracked hull, sloped glacis, wide flattened layered turret, substantial long cannon with bore, dark recessed running gear; faction color broad turret cheek plates and side skirt panels, remaining upper surfaces grey-olive. SPG: unmistakably longer narrower tracked body, tall rear-mounted angular turret, VERY long cannon; distinguish strongly from MBT. Construction truck: robust six-wheel industrial cab, functional folded yellow hydraulic crane and pale utility equipment body, visible hydraulic joints. Mining truck: stocky six-wheel industrial chassis, broad open tilting ore hopper with a modest visible load of golden ore, short cab, convincingly shaped heavy tyres. Large painted side/roof patches integrated into panels on all models, visibly blue/red from rear and front. Fine tread segmentation, bevel highlights, panel seams and windshield reflections visible at large size, but low texture noise. At bottom of every panel a small in-game-style size study on a subtle concrete patch. Smooth high fidelity game-art models, not low-poly, not pixelated, not plastic toys.
